class_name: 同格-堅い表現-トコロノ類

provenance.pipeline: satsuki v1 (v1.0.1 editorial re-edit: usage-note reshaping corpus-wide, lane discrimination for same-surface families, against prompts/style.md)

patterns.usage_note: Marks a relative clause as such, sitting between a modifying clause and its head noun where plain Japanese would simply juxtapose them (法が保護するところの利益). It adds no meaning and is almost always deletable; its work is rhythmic, keeping a long modifier from crashing into its head noun. It belongs to stiff academic, legal and philosophical prose, and sounds affected in speech.

examples.ruby: 著者[ちょしゃ]が本書[ほんしょ]で試[こころ]みるところの分析[ぶんせき]である。
examples.english: This is the analysis which the author attempts in the present volume.

examples.ruby: 我々[われわれ]が正義[せいぎ]と呼[よ]ぶところのものは何[なに]か。
examples.english: What, then, is that which we call justice?

examples.ruby: 本論[ほんろん]では、法[ほう]が保護[ほご]するところの利益[りえき]を検討[けんとう]する。
examples.english: This paper examines the interests which the law protects.
